pages.title: Experimental environment
pages.intro: This document records the environment and settings for the three research questions and their sensitivity analyses. Tables S16–S25 follow supplementary results Tables S1–S15; Setting values are listed separately where they differ between experiments. Source entries R01–R35 refer to the accompanying source index.
